item.title: Bellefonte B&B Wins International Sustainability Award
item.description: A Bellefonte bed and breakfast has achieved a major recognition for its environmental care. The Queen, A Victorian Bed and Breakfast recently the Bronze Award from Green Tourism, an international certification program known for its high standards in the hospitality industry. The honor follows The Queen's 2024 Emerald Award from the Centre County Recycling and Refuse Authority for the B&B's excellence in recycling and waste reduction. item.title: Man Killed in Crash on I-80 in Centre County
item.description: Updated 2:31 p.m. Jan. 29. A 64-year-old man died after a single-vehicle crash Thursday morning on Interstate 80 in Centre County, according to state police. Douglas W. Huling, 64, of Lycoming County, was driving a 2014 Ford F-150 pickup truck near mile marker 151 of I-80 westbound in Boggs Township at 7:08 a.m. when for unknown reasons he abruptly swerved toward the median, police wrote in a crash report. item.title: Penn State Women’s Hockey Embracing Historic Game at Beaver Stadium
item.description: This upcoming weekend will mark a first for Penn State women’s hockey. item.title: 2 People Displaced by House Fire in State College
item.description: A family of two was displaced after a fire caused damage to their home in State College on Wednesday night. Alpha Fire Company was dispatched at about 8:20 p.m. to the 1200 block of Old Boalsburg Road, where a caller reported flames coming from a window of the home. item.title: Cael Sanderson Looks Ahead to Penn State Wrestling’s Showdown With Nebraska
item.description: Penn State wrestling has set the standard this season, not just in the Big Ten, but across all college wrestling. Coach Cael Sanderson and his team have been rolling through opponents, earning two shutout victories over Indiana and Maryland in just 24 hours last weekend. Those victories marked a new program record, with the Nittany Lions recording seven shutouts this season. item.title: Your Guide to Penn State’s ‘Winter Sports Weekend,’ First Beaver Stadium Hockey Games
item.description: Penn State Athletics will stage its first “Winter Sports Weekend” from Friday through Sunday, bringing 15 athletic events and a slate of fan activities to campus, highlighted by outdoor ice hockey games at Beaver Stadium. The three-day weekend includes the first men’s and women’s hockey games played at Beaver Stadium. item.title: Centre County United Way to Hold Campaign Celebration
item.description: Centre County United Way will host a celebration event in February to mark the conclusion of its 2025 Annual Campaign.
